# 1: Data Collection
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# 1.0 Install & Load Packages
# install.packages(c("frenchdata", "quantmod", "tidyverse", "readxl", "lubridate"))

library(frenchdata)
library(quantmod)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)

# 1.1 Fama-French 6 Factor Data
# Source: Kenneth French Data Library (via frenchdata package)

ff6 <- download_french_data("Fama/French 5 Factors (2x3)")
ff_mom <- download_french_data("Momentum Factor (Mom)")

# Extract monthly data
ff6_monthly <- ff6$subsets$data[[1]] %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste0(date, "01"), format = "%Y%m%d")) %>%
  rename(MKT = `Mkt-RF`) %>%
  select(date, MKT, SMB, HML, RMW, CMA, RF)

mom_monthly <- ff_mom$subsets$data[[1]] %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste0(date, "01"), format = "%Y%m%d")) %>%
  rename(MOM = Mom) %>%
  select(date, MOM)

# Merge FF factors
ff_data <- ff6_monthly %>%
  left_join(mom_monthly, by = "date") %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("1990-01-01"),
         date <= as.Date("2023-12-01")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(MKT, SMB, HML, RMW, CMA, MOM, RF), ~ . / 100))

cat("FF Data:", nrow(ff_data), "monthly observations\n")


# 1.2 Goyal-Welch Macroeconomic Predictors
# Download Data2024.xlsx from Amit Goyal's website https://sites.google.com/view/agoyal145
# https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10_nkOkJPvq4eZgNl-1ys63PzhbnM3S2y/edit?usp=
# sharing&ouid=113571510202500088860&rtpof=true&sd=true

gw_raw <- read_excel("/Users/vitozhao/Downloads/Data2024.xlsx", sheet = "Monthly")

gw_data <- gw_raw %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste0(yyyymm, "01"), format = "%Y%m%d")) %>%
  select(date,
         dp   = `d/p`,  # Dividend-price ratio
         ep   = `e/p`,  # Earnings-price ratio
         bm   = `b/m`,  # Book-to-market ratio
         tbl,           # T-bill rate
         lty,           # Long-term yield
         tms,           # Term spread
         dfy,           # Default yield spread
         dfr,           # Default return spread
         infl,          # Inflation
         ltr,           # Long-term return
         svar           # Stock variance
  ) %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("1990-01-01"),
         date <= as.Date("2023-12-01"))

cat("GW Data:", nrow(gw_data), "monthly observations\n")


# 1.3 VIX Data for Regime Classification
# Source: Yahoo Finance via quantmod

getSymbols("^VIX", src = "yahoo",
           from = "1990-01-01",
           to   = "2023-12-31",
           auto.assign = TRUE)

vix_xts <- to.monthly(VIX, indexAt = "firstof")
vix_monthly <- data.frame(
  date = as.Date(index(vix_xts)),
  VIX  = as.numeric(Cl(vix_xts))
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(VIX),
         date >= as.Date("1990-01-01"),
         date <= as.Date("2023-12-01"))

cat("VIX Data:", nrow(vix_monthly), "monthly observations\n")


# 1.4 Merge All Data

master_data <- ff_data %>%
  left_join(gw_data, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(vix_monthly, by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date)

cat("\nMissing values per column:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(master_data)))

cat("\nFinal dataset:", nrow(master_data), "rows,",
    ncol(master_data), "columns\n")
cat("Period:", as.character(min(master_data$date)),
    "to", as.character(max(master_data$date)), "\n")
```


# 2: Data Preprocessing
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# 2.1 Use Lag Predictors by 1 Month to avoid look-ahead bias
# X at time t predicts Y at time t+1

predictors <- c("dp", "ep", "bm", "tbl", "lty", "tms",
                "dfy", "dfr", "infl", "ltr", "svar")

factors <- c("MKT", "SMB", "HML", "RMW", "CMA", "MOM")

model_data <- master_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(predictors), ~ lag(., 1))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dp))  # remove first row lost due to lagging

cat("After lagging predictors:", nrow(model_data), "rows\n")


# 2.2 Winsorize Predictors at 1% / 99% to handle outliers

winsorize <- function(x, lower = 0.01, upper = 0.99) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = c(lower, upper), na.rm = TRUE)
  pmax(pmin(x, q[2]), q[1])
}

model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(predictors), winsorize))


# 2.3 Standardize Predictors

model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(predictors), ~ scale(.)[, 1]))


# 2.4 Regime Classification using VIX
# Low volatility:  VIX <= median
# High volatility: VIX >  median

vix_median <- median(model_data$VIX, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("VIX median threshold:", round(vix_median, 2), "\n")

model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(regime = ifelse(VIX <= vix_median, "low_vol", "high_vol"),
         regime = factor(regime, levels = c("low_vol", "high_vol")))

cat("\nRegime distribution:\n")
print(table(model_data$regime))

# 2.5 Summary Check

cat("\nFinal model_data:", nrow(model_data), "rows,",
    ncol(model_data), "columns\n")
cat("Missing values:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(model_data)))
```


# 3: Model Definitions
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# install.packages(c("glmnet", "randomForest", "nnet"))
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(nnet)

# LASSO
fit_lasso <- function(X_train, y_train, X_test) {
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 1, nfolds = 5)
  predict(cv_fit, newx = X_test, s = "lambda.min")[1]
}

# Random Forest
fit_rf <- function(X_train, y_train, X_test) {
  model <- randomForest(x = X_train, y = y_train,
                        ntree = 200, mtry = 4)
  predict(model, newdata = X_test)
}

# Neural Network (MLP)
fit_nn <- function(X_train, y_train, X_test) {
  model <- nnet(x = X_train, y = y_train,
                size = 5, linout = TRUE,
                decay = 0.01, maxit = 200,
                trace = FALSE)
  predict(model, newdata = X_test)[1]
}
```


# 4: Rolling Window Prediction
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# 4.0 Setup
set.seed(423)
train_window <- 60        # 60 months training window
n <- nrow(model_data)
dates <- model_data$date

# Empty matrices to store predictions (rows = time, cols = factors)
pred_lasso <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = length(factors),
                     dimnames = list(NULL, factors))
pred_rf <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = length(factors),
                  dimnames = list(NULL, factors))
pred_nn <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = length(factors),
                  dimnames = list(NULL, factors))

# 4.1 Rolling Window Loop
cat("Running rolling window predictions...\n")

for (t in (train_window + 1):n) {

  train_idx <- (t - train_window):(t - 1)

  X_train <- as.matrix(model_data[train_idx, predictors])
  X_test <- as.matrix(model_data[t, predictors])

  for (fac in factors) {
    y_train <- model_data[[fac]][train_idx]

    pred_lasso[t, fac] <- fit_lasso(X_train, y_train, X_test)
    pred_rf[t, fac] <- fit_rf(X_train, y_train, X_test)
    pred_nn[t, fac] <- fit_nn(X_train, y_train, X_test)
  }

  if (t %% 12 == 0) cat("Done:", as.character(dates[t]), "\n")
}

# 4.2 Collect results into one data frame
results <- model_data %>%
  select(date, regime, all_of(factors)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("actual_", .), all_of(factors)) %>%
  bind_cols(
    as.data.frame(pred_lasso) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("lasso_", .)),
    as.data.frame(pred_rf) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("rf_", .)),
    as.data.frame(pred_nn) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("nn_", .))
  ) %>%
  slice((train_window + 1):n)   # keep only out-of-sample rows

cat("Out-of-sample predictions stored:", nrow(results), "rows\n")
```


# 5: Evaluation Matrices
```{r,warning=FALSE}
# 5.1 Out-of-Sample R² function

oos_r2 <- function(actual, predicted) {
  benchmark <- mean(actual, na.rm = TRUE)
  mse_model <- mean((actual - predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  mse_benchmark <- mean((actual - benchmark)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  1 - mse_model / mse_benchmark
}

# 5.2 Compute R²_oos for each model × factor × regime

models <- c("lasso", "rf", "nn")
regimes <- c("full", "low_vol", "high_vol")

r2_results <- expand.grid(model = models,
                          factor = factors,
                          regime = regimes,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(r2_oos = NA_real_)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(r2_results))) {
  mod <- r2_results$model[i]
  fac <- r2_results$factor[i]
  reg <- r2_results$regime[i]

  if (reg == "full") {
    sub <- results
  } else {
    sub <- results %>% filter(regime == reg)
  }

  actual <- sub[[paste0("actual_", fac)]]
  predicted <- sub[[paste0(mod, "_", fac)]]

  r2_results$r2_oos[i] <- oos_r2(actual, predicted)
}

cat("\nOut-of-Sample R² by Model and Factor\n")
r2_wide <- r2_results %>%
  filter(regime == "full") %>%
  select(model, factor, r2_oos) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = factor, values_from = r2_oos) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
print(r2_wide)

cat("\nR²_oos by Regime\n")
r2_regime <- r2_results %>%
  filter(regime != "full") %>%
  group_by(model, regime) %>%
  summarise(avg_r2 = round(mean(r2_oos), 4), .groups = "drop")
print(r2_regime)

# 5.3 Sharpe Ratio of Long-Short Factor Rotation Strategy
# Each month: go long the factor with highest predicted return,
#             short the factor with lowest predicted return

sharpe <- function(returns) {
  mean(returns, na.rm = TRUE) / sd(returns, na.rm = TRUE) * sqrt(12)
}

strategy_returns <- data.frame(date = results$date, regime = results$regime)

for (mod in models) {
  pred_cols <- paste0(mod, "_", factors)
  strat_returns <- numeric(nrow(results))
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(results))) {
    preds <- as.numeric(results[j, pred_cols])
    long_ret <- results[j, paste0("actual_", factors[which.max(preds)])]
    short_ret <- results[j, paste0("actual_", factors[which.min(preds)])]
    strat_returns[j] <- as.numeric(long_ret) - as.numeric(short_ret)
  }
  
  strategy_returns[[mod]] <- strat_returns

  cat("\nSharpe Ratio -", toupper(mod), "strategy:", round(sharpe(strat_returns), 3))
  cat("(low_vol:", round(sharpe(strat_returns[results$regime == "low_vol"]), 3), ")")
  cat("(high_vol:", round(sharpe(strat_returns[results$regime == "high_vol"]), 3), ")\n")
}

# 5.4 Hit Ratio
# Proportion of months where predicted direction matches actual direction

hit_ratio <- function(actual, predicted) {
  correct <- sign(actual) == sign(predicted)
  mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE)
}

hit_results <- expand.grid(model  = models,
                           factor = factors,
                           regime = regimes,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(hit = NA_real_)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(hit_results))) {
  mod <- hit_results$model[i]
  fac <- hit_results$factor[i]
  reg <- hit_results$regime[i]

  if (reg == "full") {
    sub <- results
  } else {
    sub <- results %>% filter(regime == reg)
  }

  actual <- sub[[paste0("actual_", fac)]]
  predicted <- sub[[paste0(mod, "_", fac)]]

  hit_results$hit[i] <- hit_ratio(actual, predicted)
}

cat("\nHit Ratio by Model and Factor (Full Sample)\n")
hit_wide <- hit_results %>%
  filter(regime == "full") %>%
  select(model, factor, hit) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = factor, values_from = hit) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
print(hit_wide)

cat("\nAverage Hit Ratio by Model and Regime\n")
hit_regime <- hit_results %>%
  filter(regime != "full") %>%
  group_by(model, regime) %>%
  summarise(avg_hit = round(mean(hit), 4), .groups = "drop")
print(hit_regime)
```


# 6: Plots
```{r,warning=FALSE}
# 6.1 Cumulative Returns of Long-Short Strategy by Model
# Build strategy return series for each model

# Cumulative returns
cum_returns <- strategy_returns %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(models), ~ cumsum(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(models), names_to = "model", values_to = "cum_return") %>%
  mutate(model = toupper(model))

regime_bands <- results %>%
  mutate(xmin = date,
         xmax = lead(date, default = last(date)),
         fill_color = ifelse(regime == "high_vol", "High Volatility", "Low Volatility"))

p1 <- ggplot(cum_returns, aes(x = date, y = cum_return, color = model)) +
  geom_rect(data = regime_bands,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = fill_color),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Returns of Long-Short Factor Rotation Strategy",
       x = NULL, y = "Cumulative Return", color = "Model", fill = "Regime") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("LASSO" = "blue3",
                                "RF" = "green3",
                                "NN" = "coral")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low Volatility"  = "green",
                               "High Volatility" = "red")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y",
               limits = c(min(results$date), max(results$date)))
print(p1)

# 6.2 Rolling 12-Month Sharpe Ratio by Model over Time

roll_window <- 12

rolling_sharpe <- data.frame(date = results$date)

for (mod in models) {
  ret <- strategy_returns[[mod]]
  rs  <- numeric(length(ret))
  for (j in seq_along(ret)) {
    if (j < roll_window) {
      rs[j] <- NA
    } else {
      window_ret <- ret[(j - roll_window + 1):j]
      rs[j] <- mean(window_ret) / sd(window_ret) * sqrt(12)
    }
  }
  rolling_sharpe[[toupper(mod)]] <- rs
}

rolling_sharpe_long <- rolling_sharpe %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = toupper(models), names_to = "model", values_to = "sharpe") %>%
  left_join(results %>% select(date, regime), by = "date") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sharpe))


p2 <- ggplot(rolling_sharpe_long, aes(x = date, y = sharpe, color = model)) +
  geom_rect(data = regime_bands,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = fill_color),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Rolling 12-Month Sharpe Ratio by Model",
       x = NULL, y = "Annualized Sharpe Ratio",
       color = "Model", fill = "Regime") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("LASSO" = "blue3",
                                "RF" = "green3",
                                "NN" = "coral")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low Volatility"  = "green",
                               "High Volatility" = "red")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y",
               limits = c(min(results$date), max(results$date)))
print(p2)

# 6.3 Rolling 12-Month Hit Ratio by Model over Time

rolling_hit <- data.frame(date = results$date)

for (mod in models) {
  rh <- numeric(nrow(results))
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(results))) {
    if (j < roll_window) {
      rh[j] <- NA
    } else {
      window_idx <- (j - roll_window + 1):j
      # Compute hit ratio per factor first, then average across factors
      hit_per_factor <- sapply(factors, function(f) {
        actual <- results[[paste0("actual_", f)]][window_idx]
        predicted <- results[[paste0(mod, "_", f)]][window_idx]
        mean(sign(actual) == sign(predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
      })
      rh[j] <- mean(hit_per_factor, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  rolling_hit[[toupper(mod)]] <- rh
}

rolling_hit_long <- rolling_hit %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = toupper(models), names_to = "model", values_to = "hit") %>%
  left_join(results %>% select(date, regime), by = "date") %>%
  filter(!is.na(hit))

p3 <- ggplot(rolling_hit_long, aes(x = date, y = hit, color = model)) +
  geom_rect(data = regime_bands,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = fill_color),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Rolling 12-Month Hit Ratio by Model",
       subtitle = "Dashed = 0.5 random benchmark",
       x = NULL, y = "Hit Ratio", color = "Model", fill = "Regime") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("LASSO" = "blue3",
                                "RF" = "green3",
                                "NN" = "coral")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low Volatility"  = "green",
                               "High Volatility" = "red")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y",
               limits = c(min(results$date), max(results$date)))
print(p3)

# 6.4 Rolling 12-Month Out-of-Sample R² by Model over Time

rolling_r2 <- data.frame(date = results$date)

for (mod in models) {
  rr <- numeric(nrow(results))
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(results))) {
    if (j < roll_window) {
      rr[j] <- NA
    } else {
      window_idx <- (j - roll_window + 1):j
      r2_vals <- sapply(factors, function(f) {
        actual <- results[[paste0("actual_", f)]][window_idx]
        predicted <- results[[paste0(mod, "_", f)]][window_idx]
        benchmark <- mean(actual, na.rm = TRUE)
        1 - mean((actual - predicted)^2) / mean((actual - benchmark)^2)
      })
      rr[j] <- mean(r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  rolling_r2[[toupper(mod)]] <- rr
}

rolling_r2_long <- rolling_r2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = toupper(models), names_to = "model", values_to = "r2") %>%
  filter(!is.na(r2))

p4 <- ggplot(rolling_r2_long, aes(x = date, y = r2, color = model)) +
  geom_rect(data = regime_bands,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = fill_color),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Rolling 12-Month Out-of-Sample R² by Model",
       subtitle = "Dashed = historical mean benchmark",
       x = NULL, y = "Average R²_oos (across factors)", color = "Model", fill = "Regime") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("LASSO" = "blue3",
                                "RF" = "green3",
                                "NN" = "coral")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low Volatility"  = "green",
                               "High Volatility" = "red")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y",
               limits = c(min(results$date), max(results$date))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-5, 0.1))
print(p4)
```
